traits.name: Towering Strength
traits.text: A gug can lift items up to 4,000 pounds as a bonus action.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.text: The gug makes two slam attacks, two stomp attacks, or one of each.

actions.name: Slam
actions.text: Melee Weapon Attack: +11 to hit, reach 10 ft., one creature. Hit: 16 (2d8 + 7) bludgeoning damage. If a creature is hit by this attack twice in the same turn, the target must make a successful DC 19 Constitution saving throw or gain one level of exhaustion.

actions.name: Stomp
actions.text: Melee Weapon Attack. +11 to hit, reach 10 ft. Hit: 20 (2d12 + 7) bludgeoning damage.
